name: Interference
description: Three ring sources drifting through space and beating against each other, their rings opening out as they come toward the lens and packing tight as they fall away. Almost free, and hypnotic on quiet passages.

frequency.description: Rings per world unit. Read in the scene, not on the screen, so the same value gives wide rings up close and fine ones at the back.

separation.description: How far the sources swing off the view axis.

depth.description: How far the sources travel toward and away from the camera. 0 pins them all at one distance and the effect flattens back to the old two-centre version.

third.description: How much the third source modulates the beat of the first two. 0 leaves a clean, periodic interference.

bloom.description: Light a source throws into the frame as it passes the camera — the near/far cue the pattern itself cannot give.
